portInfo.description: Warnemünde combines a beach-resort promenade with a serious cruise terminal. Guests split between lighthouse/Alter Strom strolls, Rostock’s city centre via S-Bahn, and ambitious Berlin day coaches. Multi-ship days (165 calls in 2025) mean queues—protect the return buffer.

gettingThere.walkingTime: 5-10 minutes to village center—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Train station with connections to Rostock and Berlin

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Alter Strom / Warnemünde lighthouse and beach promenade: allow 60–90 minutes. Sand and wind.
Rostock old town (via S-Bahn): allow 2.5–3.5 hours including the ~20-minute S-Bahn each way and a city walk—estimate.
Local seafood lunch along Alter Strom: allow 45–60 minutes.
Organised Berlin day tour: only with ship-timed coaches; independent Berlin needs ≥2h rail each way plus urban time and contingency.
Tea-museum / local indoor option: rainy-day spare—check hours.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Photograph the Cruise Center lettering before boarding a Berlin coach; Warnemünde and Rostock returns can confuse tired guests.
